name: Smart Click Sounds
description: Realistic click sounds that react to how you click: lighter spam, matched releases, no repeats.

spam.name: Spam / fast clicks
spam.description: How much lighter fast clicks sound. Clicks 150 ms+ apart are always full strength.

variation.name: Variation
variation.description: How different each variation is: blends of similar recorded clicks plus small pitch, tone, hit and ring changes.

variations.name: Click variations
variations.description: How many different click variations to make from the recorded clicks. Each one is used once before any repeats.

clean-tone.name: Clean tone
clean-tone.description: Removes the desk 'boom' so clicks sound crisp instead of clunky.

pack-folder.name: Click pack folder
pack-folder.description: Leave empty to use your GDClickbot pack (Documents\GDClickbot\clickpack) if it exists, otherwise the pack built into this mod. Or paste any clickpack folder (with player1\clicks, or clicks + releases folders).
